title: A page request with a refresh just before expiry
caption: OADR-0018 point 3. The middleware refreshes once per refresh token in the process (lib/refresh-dedup.ts) and rewrites both the response cookies and the request's own Cookie header, so the page already uses the new token. Server components never refresh.
